title: GGT–ALP coupling adds no reliable cross-cycle prediction of the prebronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio
abstract: A registered product of source-standardized log serum GGT and log alkaline phosphatase was added to flexible conventional enzyme, demographic and smoking predictors of prebronchodilator FEV1/FVC. Training used NHANES2007–08 adults20–79 (n=3510); frozen transfer used the separately recruited NHANES2009–10 sample (n=3910). Target weighted MSE worsened from43.251250 to43.252298 percentage-points squared. Joint source–target survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval for MSE gain was[−0.044692,0.031355]. Source cross-validation and regularization checks were also negative. This specific feature provides no demonstrated incremental prediction. Validation is between cycles of one survey, not independent institutions, and does not establish a causal liver–lung mechanism or clinical utility.
